---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something Vaani X should do
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What cannot you do today? Describe the use case, not just the feature.

## Proposed change

What should change? Which surface (`/api/v1/*`, `/v1/*`, core, bench, Docker)?

## Low-resource check

Vaani X's product is being small. Does this change add a dependency, RAM, or disk? If so, what does it buy, and can it be opt-in (a tier, a flag, a separate pack) instead of default?

## Accuracy check

If this changes ASR or TTS quality, how would it be measured? (Frozen set, WER + CER + AER, n ≥ 200 — see `docs/benchmark_results.md`.) If it cannot be measured, say so.

## Alternatives

What did you consider instead, and why is this better?

## Willing to contribute?

- [ ] I can open a PR (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
